tasks.label: run Rigsight (agent + app)
tasks.detail: Starts the background agent (asks for admin once) and opens the app.

tasks.label: quit agent
tasks.detail: Asks the running agent to exit (so a rebuild can replace it).
tasks.command: $p = New-Object System.IO.Pipes.NamedPipeClientStream '.', 'Rigsight.Agent.v1', 'InOut'; try { $p.Connect(2000); $w = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter $p; $w.WriteLine('{"T":"cmd","Cmd":"quit"}'); $w.Flush(); Start-Sleep 2 } catch { 'Agent is not running.' } finally { $p.Dispose() }

tasks.label: publish
tasks.detail: Builds a release folder (publish/) with both programs; no .NET install needed to run it.
tasks.command: dotnet publish src/Rigsight.Agent -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o publish; dotnet publish src/Rigsight -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o publish

tasks.label: build installer
tasks.detail: Creates dist/Rigsight-Setup-<version>.exe to share with others (needs Inno Setup).
